name: Overload Festival Dhaka (X Force Presents)

venue.name: Hall of Fame, Bangladesh China Friendship Conference Center (BCCC)

notes: Large-scale multi-band metal festival bringing together three of the pioneering Bangladeshi metal acts (Artcell, Cryptic Fate, Warfaze) on one bill, illustrating the continued vitality of large-format metal festivals in the mid-2020s Dhaka scene. Full supporting lineup ('other prominent bands') not yet itemized in available sources.
